notes: Tuition: the only fee stated on the page is 178 euros per year, a figure for Parcoursup/French-student fees ('Par année 178 euros.'); the Campus France page on differentiated fees (2 902 euros for a Licence year) is a national/general page about public establishments, not this programme's own fee statement, so no tuition fact is given. Intakes: the page gives Parcoursup phase dates ('analysent les candidatures en avril-mai 2026', 'du 2 juin 2026') that apply to Parcoursup candidates and are for responses, not a non-EU applicant deadline; no application deadline for international/foreign-diploma applicants is stated on these pages. ApplicationChannel: omitted per the task; the supplied Ut Capitole/RGPD page is unreadable (corrupted encoding) and contributed no facts. Language: the programme is taught in French (C1 French level required); 'Langue vivante 1 : Anglais' is a language course within the programme, not the teaching language.
